intake.description: Seen. The partner may still be writing, or the quiet window is running.

working.description: A coding agent is working on this right now.

needs-partner.description: The agent asked a question and is waiting for the partner to answer.

needs-owner.description: Waiting on the repo owner: a decision, an escalation, or a crashed run.

deployed.description: Live. The partner has been asked to try it.

budget.description: Today's dispatch limit was reached. This will resume tomorrow.

pr-reviewing.description: A review of this pull request is owed, or in progress.

pr-approved.description: Reviewed and approved. It may be merged once the checks pass and the veto window closes.

pr-changes.description: Reviewed: changes were requested. A new push gets a new review.

pr-declined.description: Reviewed: the reviewer thinks this should not be merged as it is. The owner decides.

pr-merged.description: Merged by liaise after its review.

hold.description: Keeps liaise from merging this pull request. Remove it to let the merge go ahead.
